title: tc-kpi-chart
description: A metric card with a multi-line chart, a legend and a hover tooltip.

delta.description: Change against the previous period – a rise is green and a drop red, unless `lowerIsBetter`

lowerIsBetter.description: A drop is the good direction (latency, cost, error rate): a negative `delta` shows green, a positive one red

labels.description: Short labels along the x-axis, e.g. "Mar 4"

tooltipLabels.description: Longer labels for the tooltip header, e.g. "Tue, Mar 4" – falls back to `labels`

series.description: The lines, each with a label, an optional colour and one value per label – every line also gets its own stroke pattern

legend.description: A legend naming each line – unset shows it when there are two or more lines; legend="false" hides it

defaultIndex.description: Point that stays highlighted while nobody hovers – unset hides the tooltip at rest

index.description: The highlighted point, or null for none (then `defaultIndex` shows)

fill.description: Fill the container: no max-width, the card stretches and the plot grows with its height

color.description: Line colour: any CSS colour, including a token such as `var(--tc-chart-2)` – it is applied through CSS, so custom properties resolve. Unset takes the next `--tc-chart-1…6` token

values.description: One value per label, same length as `labels`
